whatsappMessage:
Hi Team DOYEN THE GYM,

I noticed your gym has strong 4.6★ reviews from 330+ members on Fraser Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new membership inquiries.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, workout programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://doyen.arclanestudios.space

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi DOYEN THE GYM team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp booking and mobile-first speed for Fraser Road members. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact training programs aur actual photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain."
